coder_notes: One registered intervention bundles bevacizumab, irinotecan and re-radiotherapy; split into drug rows. Bevacizumab is an established GBM therapy (D6) tested here in a new setting (with re-irradiation), coded established_therapy_experiment (could alternatively be soc_backbone; not a candidate either way). Irinotecan is not on the D6 established list, so it is the only investigational agent -> experimental_monotherapy. 'WHO grade 4 glioma' without IDH requirement = historical glioblastoma (D27C); conditions name recurrent glioblastoma.
